issues.problem: Method evaluates on black (official, and what the paper's 3DGS/CoR-GS rows also use) but the gsplat baseline and the dataset protocol_id record 'background: white', so method-vs-gsplat deltas mix a protocol difference. Measured effect is negligible on full-coverage LLFF.
issues.evidence: Re-rendered smoke-1 horns test views from checkpoint.pt: PSNR black 17.935 vs white 17.972 (0.04 dB); mean alpha 0.999, 0.17% of pixels with alpha<0.9. Official train.py:135 / render.py:114 use black when white_background is False.
issues.fix: Keep black for paper comparison; also report the AD-GS 10k run under white (or run the baseline with black) and record the eval background in the result, so the comparison is explicit. Re-check alpha coverage on the 10k checkpoints (fortress/room have wider baselines).

issues.problem: Pseudo-pose near/far are recomputed from percentiles of the initial cloud instead of the official poses_bounds.npy bounds, which prep.json already stores (train_bounds_poses_bounds_npy). Changes the focus distance (+6% on horns) and so every pseudo look-at.
issues.evidence: official pose_utils.py:320-366 uses view.bounds (poses_bounds.npy[idx,-2:]); plan.md gap 5.
issues.fix: Add a pseudo_bounds config (min/max over the 3 train views from prep.json) and use it when present.

issues.problem: Known runtime deviations: SH degree +1 every 1000 steps (official every 500, train.py:~180), views sampled with replacement (official pops a shuffled stack), valid-conv SSIM in L_ph/L_pseudo (official same-padding), optimizer step before densify.
issues.fix: Accept for the first benchmark; if the PSNR gap vs paper exceeds ~0.5 dB, ablate SH-500 first.

issues.problem: No probe covers the opacity-reset steps (3501/6501/9501, value 0.05, both fields), G2 clone-at-init equality with G1, or G2's own densification being driven by G2's own gradients.
issues.evidence: probes: alternating-densification, phase-gated-losses, edge-aware-depth, pseudo-view-consistency only.
issues.fix: Add a CPU probe asserting reset at 3501 (not 3500/3502) on both fields and partner params == main params after initialize.

issues.problem: train() reports on split 'validation' = the 33-51 unused non-test images; only ss-eval --split test gives the paper-protocol number. Easy to mis-report.
issues.evidence: runtime.py measure(..., 'validation'); transforms.json val_filenames = unused images.
issues.fix: Benchmark must read test.json from ss-eval, never validation.json.

equation_coverage.code: losses.py:create_cotraining (other field detached, /(N-1)=1, low phase and step>=500, same random bg)

probe_assessment.why: Checks schedule against independent formula and per-phase clone/prune counts on a fixture.
Depth loss must be nonzero exactly at steps 1700,1799.
Compared to a per-pixel loop plus finite-difference gradient.
Requires G1 and G2 gradients from detached-target pseudo loss (CUDA).

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: Few-view protocol verified: for fortress/horns/room transforms.json train/test lists equal an independent recomputation (test = sorted idx%8==0; train = round(linspace(0,len-1,3)) over the remainder, banker's rounding as in dataset_readers.py:349-360 and colmap_llff.py); val = remaining images, disjoint, covering all frames (42/62/41).
Resolution 1008x756 = round(4032/4) x round(3024/4); PIL bicubic matches official PILtoTorch resize; focal scaled, principal point centred like the official projection.

COLMAP init: colmap/images holds exactly the 3 training images in each scene, database built fresh, 3 'Processed file' entries; pipeline options identical to tools/colmap_llff.py; poses from the full-view sparse model as in the official code. Runtime scene extent uses train split only (3 cameras), like getNerfppNorm.

Densification: clone/split/FSGS-dist criterion/opacity prune, thresholds 5e-4/0.005 (warm), 5e-4/0.1 (low), 2e-4/0.005 (high), interval 100 from step>500, until <10000, N_W=1500, cycle 200, N_H=100 all match train.py:168-169,384-401 and gaussian_model.py; opacity reset min(op,0.05) at (s-501)%3000==0 matches train.py:412.

Co-training: G2 cloned after knn scales/LR scaling (same init as official), own Adam with eps 1e-15, own densification from its own main-view means2d grads, G1 evaluated (official gs0), own depth loss, pseudo target detached both ways.
Depth is accumulated z (forward.cu:361) via gsplat RGB+D; random per-iteration train bg shared across G1/G2/pseudo renders, black bg under no_grad.
paper_results.json llff-3view method and baseline_3dgs per-scene PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS and averages match main.tex Scene-wise LLFF 3-view table (AD-GS and 3DGS rows) exactly; averages recompute correctly.
summary: No critical or major issues. Split, resolution, resampling and 3-view-only COLMAP init reproduce the official protocol; schedules, thresholds, resets, co-training and losses match the official code operator by operator. Black eval is the official protocol and costs/gains only ~0.04 dB on full-coverage LLFF (alpha 0.999 on smoke horns) but should be reported alongside a white eval or a black-eval baseline. Remaining deviations are minor (pseudo-pose bounds from percentiles, SH schedule, with-replacement view sampling, valid-conv SSIM).
